content: शिशुः [शो-कु सन्वद्भावः द्वित्वम्; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 1. 20</ls>] .²1 A child, an infant; शिशुर्वा शिष्या वा <ls>U. 4. 11</ls>. .²2 The young of any animal (as a calf, puppy, fawn <ab>&c.</ab>); नष्टाशङ्का हरिणशिशवो मन्दमन्दं चरन्ति <ls>Ś. 1. 15</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">7. 14</ls>, <ls n="Ś. 7.">18</ls>. .²3 A boy under eight or sixteen years of age. .²4 A pupil, scholar. .²5 An elephant in the sixty year; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 5. 8</ls>.
